correctness.rationale: For every n>=3 the rational map is defined, row-stochastic in sum, symmetric and diagonal-positive. Graph distance and exact Taylor coefficients yield strict small-h positive entries to cycle size13, with the first negative distance-seven coefficient at n14. Direct rational formulas yield all-h positivity for C3,C4,C5 and a unique C6 quartic threshold, with other C6 distances remaining positive. The exact cycle Moore–Penrose kernel and large-h asymptotic prove universal nearest-neighbor negativity for every n>=6 and the limiting sign fraction 1-1/sqrt3. Replayed SymPy exact checks cover small-size rational identities, coefficients and pseudoinverse equations (438 assertions); infinity proof is analytic, not an inference from tests.

originality.rationale: The inspected full foundational texts establish method-level failure of absolute monotonicity and nonconservative eight-state Metzler examples, while an independently checked published result proves an eight-state minimum among all Markov generators using a pure-birth chain. Accessible prior local claims for paths and complete multipartite graphs have different adjacency and spectral assumptions. Their theorems do not imply the exact undirected-cycle n=6 and n=14 thresholds, complete C6 step set, or spatial asymptotic fraction. Not finding an equivalent in indexed material is qualified by possible unindexed specializations.
residual_risks: An indexed-search miss does not exclude differently worded analytic specializations in unindexed numerical-analysis literature.

value.rationale: The exact n-based trichotomy for periodic fourth-order diffusion discretizations identifies genuinely different regimes of unconditional positivity (n<=5), local positivity followed by large-step loss (6<=n<=13), and immediate plus large-step failure (n>=14). The C6 first-failure quartic and nontrivial irrational limiting fraction of negative spatial positions are motivated operational numerical boundaries not implied by the general zero-radius result. The finding deliberately refrains from claiming all intermediate-step intervals for every n.
